The top global pharmaceutical and medical companies, ranked by annual revenue and market presence, include industry giants such as Pfizer, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Merck & Co., Roche, Sanofi, AstraZeneca, Novartis, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and GSK. [](https://www.proclinical.com/blogs/2024-7/who-are-the-top-10-pharma-companies-in-the-world-2025)

- **Pfizer:** Leader in global vaccine and therapeutics sales.

- **Johnson & Johnson:** Diversified healthcare, medical tech, and pharmaceuticals.

- **AbbVie:** Strong focus on immunology and oncology treatments.

- **Merck & Co.:** Known for blockbuster oncology drugs like Keytruda.

- **Roche:** Pioneer in pharmaceuticals and molecular diagnostics.

- **Sanofi:** Major player in vaccines and rare diseases.

- **AstraZeneca:** Focused on oncology, cardiovascular, and rare conditions.

- **Novartis:** Leader in innovative medicines and advanced therapies.

- **Bristol-Myers Squibb:** Specialized in cardiovascular and cancer therapies.

- **GSK:** Renowned for global vaccines and respiratory solutions. [](https://www.proclinical.com/blogs/2024-7/who-are-the-top-10-pharma-companies-in-the-world-2025)

### Top Medical Device & Technology Companies

- **Medtronic:** Global leader in cardiac and vascular technology.

- **Abbott Laboratories:** Major force in diagnostics, medical devices, and nutrition.

- **Siemens Healthineers:** Specialized in medical imaging and laboratory diagnostics. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)
